description: Dismisses a notification card (action "dismiss"), snoozes it for its own snooze time ("snooze"), or marks it read ("read"), as the card's controls do. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: dismiss_notification
title: Dismiss a notification
